title:
What is the Cost to Start a Mobile Dog Grooming Business vs. a Franchi
 – Vanspeed PRO

facts.fact: The Vanspeed PRO article was published on July 1, 2026.
Vanspeed PRO's calculator lists a national mobile dog grooming average price of $100–$170 per groom, and states premium markets charge 20–40% more.
facts.quote: National mobile avg: $100–$170 · Premium markets charge 20–40% more

facts.fact: Vanspeed PRO's calculator sets a budget-tier price of $85 per groom for rural and small-town markets.
Vanspeed PRO's calculator sets a mid-market price of $115 per groom for suburbs and mid-sized cities.
Vanspeed PRO's calculator sets a premium-tier price of $155 per groom for NYC, LA, and Miami.
Vanspeed PRO states the industry standard is 5–8 dogs groomed per day for one groomer.
facts.quote: Industry standard: 5–8 per day for one groomer

facts.fact: Vanspeed PRO states a typical mobile groomer works 20–22 days per month on a Monday–Friday schedule.
Vanspeed PRO's calculator default scenario shows daily revenue of $690 (6 dogs at $115 each).
Vanspeed PRO's calculator default scenario shows monthly revenue of $15,180 based on 22 working days.
The page estimates annual gross revenue for a mobile dog grooming business at $182,160 before expenses.
The page estimates net profit for a mobile dog grooming business at $127,512 per year after roughly 30% expenses.
facts.quote: Est. Net Profit / yr$127,512 After ~30% expenses

facts.fact: The page estimates monthly revenue for a mobile dog grooming business at $15,180.
The page estimates monthly expenses for a mobile dog grooming business at $4,554.
The page estimates monthly net profit for a mobile dog grooming business at $10,626.
The page states that the monthly expense estimate includes fuel, supplies, insurance, and van payment.
facts.quote:
Monthly expenses include

Fuel · Supplies · Insurance · Van payment

facts.fact: The page states that a dog typically needs one grooming every 4–6 weeks.
facts.quote:
Grooming frequency

1 groom per dog every 4–6 weeks

facts.fact: The page cites US Census and AVMA 2024 together with APPA 2024–25 as its market data sources.
facts.quote:
Market data source

US Census + AVMA 2024 · APPA 2024–25
